identity_fields.locator.utf8_start/utf8_end: Zero-based half-open byte offsets in the object named by locator.byte_basis.
identity_fields.normalized_extract_identity: Identity of the derived locator stream. normalization_id names the only permitted byte transformation and derived_from_raw_extract_sha256 binds its input.
identity_fields.passage_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact half-open byte slice selected by the locator.
identity_fields.raw_extract_identity: Identity of the exact extraction file before locator normalization; its path, byte count, and SHA-256 apply to raw on-disk bytes.
identity_fields.raw_source_identity: Identity of the locally acquired source object from CANON_SOURCES.jsonl; its path, byte count, and SHA-256 apply to unmodified acquired bytes.

crlf-to-lf-v1.algorithm: On the raw extract byte string, replace every non-overlapping byte pair 0x0D 0x0A with the single byte 0x0A; preserve every other byte exactly; perform no Unicode decoding, encoding, normalization, or other transformation.
